geometry.source_topology: 28 original vertices, 48 triangular side panels, 2 quadrilateral roofs, 76 crease paths
geometry.geometry_revision: original neutral midsurface with explicit PET-only side borders and rigid perimeter frames

frames.fea_frame: lower square center at origin; upper square at z=0.0264 m; right-handed Z up
frames.isaac_frame: same axes; translated vertically for static mounting/freefall/first contact
frames.transform_fea_to_isaac: source +90 degrees X, uniform scale 0.03/250, recenter lower plane; deformation never rescaled
frames.positive_angle_direction: right-hand relative bottom-frame rotation vector in upper-frame coordinates

material.model: isotropic Green-strain membrane plus effective discrete bending hinges; no failure law

parameters.note: Effective ratio 100 makes strip bending rigidity about 1.615 times the uncreased elastic PET plate estimate; not measured pre-crease calibration. PET-only strip membrane stiffness excludes PLA.

mesh.element_type: 3-node triangular membrane and signed-dihedral discrete hinges
mesh.mesh_revision: subdivision1 explicit 0.2 mm PET strips; free panel centroids/roof interior nodes
mesh.convergence_summary: Reference surface area invariant. At 0.25 N/strand, subdivision1 to 2 changes compression by about 28%, Y bend by 40%, and twist by 12%; fails the 5% response gate. Boundary-fan enrichment is not a complete uniform h-refinement sequence. Physical spatial/crease/contact convergence not established.

boundary_conditions: Statics: upper perimeter fixed; lower perimeter free; roof interiors and side panels deformable.
Dynamics: both frames and free shell nodes carry inertia; rigid upper/lower link mass representations.
Four unilateral compliant normal foot contacts; no tangential friction. No finite-thickness self-contact solver.
loads: Statics: twelve nonnegative frame-to-frame cable tensions; optional lower-perimeter distributed resultant force; forces use current geometry.
Drop: upright whole leg released 0.07 m, unloaded cables, total assumed mass 0.05 kg, gravity 9.81 m/s^2.
Assumed upper/lower assembly masses 0.03/0.02 kg include shell allocation. Contact total stiffness 20000 N/m, damping 0.1 N*s/m.

solver.software: custom exact_joint nonlinear_shell / shell_impact in Isaac Kit, CPU Torch autograd and SciPy
solver.analysis_type: nonlinear quasistatic force continuation; backward-Euler implicit impact
solver.notes: Static residual <1e-5 J/scaled coordinate; dynamic <3e-5. Membrane guard 3%, separation >=8% neutral. Guards are model-use limits, NOT failure. Study window 8 ms after contact, GUI default 15 ms.

limitations: Full compression/bend/twist not established; does not reproduce observed large folding.
Physical prototype dimensions and load-motion calibration missing; video is qualitative reference only.
No through-thickness stress, plasticity, bond slip/delamination, damage or survival criterion.
Partial midsurface intersection guard excludes topological neighbours; misses coplanar/finite-thickness contact and CCD.
Backward Euler numerical damping; timestep tests must be repeated for other configurations.
No ML training or promotion to v8 baseline.

review.notes: Implementation checks only; engineering/physical review outstanding.
